intro: I graduated with a B.S. in Computer Science from IISER Bhopal in May 2026, and I currently work as a Project Associate (Junior Research Fellow) at **Stealth**. My work sits at the intersection of **data science, machine learning, and applied statistics**. Day to day, I work hands-on with multi-band satellite and remote sensing datasets. I am deeply drawn to probability, statistics, mathematics, and numbers, and I enjoy experimenting, observing outcomes, and building hypotheses around them.
focus: Building satellite data extraction pipelines across bands such as NDVI, analyzing the resulting remote sensing data, and developing ML models on top of it to predict crop outcomes.
direction: In the long term, I want to transition toward quant or other fields where applied statistics, ML/AI, and mathematical modeling drive the work — leaning on a sharp, rigorous handle on the underlying math.
